title: Biosynthesis and Bioactivity of Anti-Inflammatory Triterpenoids in Calendula officinalis (pot marigold)
authors: Golubova D; Salmon M; Su H; Tansley C; Kaithakottil G; Linsmith G; Schudoma S; Swarbreck D; O’Connell M; Patron N
one_liner_zh: 该文研究金盏花中抗炎三萜类化合物的生物合成与生物活性，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、转录因子结合或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Plants have been central to traditional medicine for millennia, yet the precise metabolites responsible for their therapeutic properties often remain unidentified. Moreover, the low natural abundance and structural complexity of bioactive molecules can hinder their accessibility and chemical synthesis. Here, we investigate the widely reported anti-inflammatory properties of Calendula officinalis (pot marigold), an ancient medicinal herb. We confirm C16-hydroxylated triterpenoids as key contributors to the anti-inflammatory activity of C. officinalis floral extracts and uncover a novel mechanism by which they act in modulating interleukin 6 release. Through biosynthetic pathway elucidation, we demonstrate that the oxidosqualene synthase catalysing the first committed step emerged early in Asteraceae evolution and identify residues governing product specificity. Further, we functionally characterise cytochrome P450s and acyltransferases responsible for downstream modifications. By reconstructing the complete biosynthetic pathway in the heterologous plant chassis Nicotiana benthamiana , we provide a platform for production of the anti-inflammatory components. Our work highlights how integrated studies of bioactivity and biosynthesis can unlock the therapeutic potential of medicinal plants.
abstract_zh: 数千年来，植物一直是传统医学的核心，然而负责其治疗特性的精确代谢物往往仍未明确。此外，生物活性分子的天然丰度低和结构复杂性可能阻碍其可获取性和化学合成。在此，我们研究了金盏花（Calendula officinalis，万寿菊）广泛报道的抗炎特性，这是一种古老的药用草本植物。我们确认C16-羟基化三萜类化合物是金盏花花卉提取物抗炎活性的关键贡献者，并揭示了一种它们调节白细胞介素6释放的新机制。通过生物合成途径的阐明，我们证明催化第一步关键反应的氧化角鲨烯合酶在菊科进化早期出现，并识别了决定产物特异性的残基。进一步，我们功能表征了负责下游修饰的细胞色素P450和酰基转移酶。通过在异源植物底盘本氏烟（Nicotiana benthamiana）中重建完整生物合成途径，我们为抗炎成分的生产提供了一个平台。我们的工作强调了生物活性和生物合成的整合研究如何能够解锁药用植物的治疗潜力。
